"instructions": "# ML Hooks Configuration - Confirmation Handoff

## Summary
Fixed the ML data collection system that was losing 99.6% of training data. The hook configuration has been updated in ~/.claude/settings.json.

## What Was Done
1. Accepted and verified handoff H-20260103-084252-59037b52
2. Confirmed test isolation fix is working (no metrics pollution)
3. Fixed hook configuration by adding ML hooks to global settings with cwd:Opus-code-test matcher

## Your Task: Confirm Hooks Are Working

### Step 1: Check SessionStart Hook
At the START of your session, you should see output from ml-session-start-hook.sh
If you see an ML banner or GoT context output, the hook is running ✅

### Step 2: Work Normally
Do some work in the session (doesn't matter what)

### Step 3: End Session Cleanly
Commit and push all changes before ending

### Step 4: In NEXT Session, Verify Capture
```bash
tail -5 .git-ml/tracked/sessions.jsonl

python scripts/ml_data_collector.py stats
```
Sessions count should be > 186

### Step 6: Complete Task
```bash
python scripts/got_utils.py task complete T-20260103-090732-f89debb2 --retrospective "..."
```
